summary: magnus-server env-schema no longer lists the retired Security Fusion local-mode settings and the dead local-mode startup check is removed; SECURITY_FUSION_MODE=local is still refused at startup. docker/compose.yml defaults MAGNUS_VERSION to 3, and magnus-server --help names --allow-major for agents upgrade. No migrations, new settings, browser contract or protocol changes; Ardent remains pinned to 3.1.3.
